name: web-search
description: Keyless multi-engine web search, clean-Markdown fetch, and paginated read for AI agents, plus arxiv and github lookup. Bundles a portable SKILL, a FastMCP stdio server (web_search, web_fetch, web_open, arxiv_search, github_search), and a doctor that self-tests every engine and the optional proxy, VPN, and SearXNG layers. Needs internet; no API keys.
